<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use App\Models\User;
use App\Enums\Role;

$student = User::where('role', 'student')->whereNotNull('program_id')->first();
$collegeId = $student?->program?->college_id;
$staff = User::query()->staffResponsibleFor($collegeId)->orderBy('name')->get();

echo 'Options that would render:'.PHP_EOL;
foreach ($staff as $s) {
    echo '  <option value="'.$s->id.'">'.$s->name.' ('.$s->role->label().')</option>'.PHP_EOL;
}

echo PHP_EOL.'Role::label() check:'.PHP_EOL;
foreach (Role::cases() as $r) {
    echo '  '.$r->value.' => "'.$r->label().'"'.PHP_EOL;
}
